article_limitations: Six-patient case series; the abstract and discussion statements about all treated patients are series-level and were not copied to individuals.
The source does not state the risankizumab regimen beyond standard or labeled dosage (and 150 mg for Case 5); no dosing interval was inferred.
Uric acid for Case 3 is printed as 480 without a unit; no unit was inferred.
Baseline PASI, BSA and DLQI values follow each case text; week numbers are as printed and no anchor date or start-of-treatment date is stated.
The series statement that all 6 cases are EP is applied to Cases 1 and 3 (no conflicting wording); for Case 5 it conflicts with the described suberythroderma and stays review-only.
